idea: Size-class realisability search: fix 2–3 size classes with counts (n1, n2, n3) and sides (s1, s2, s3) tied by small integer ratios. Maximise Σ n_i s_i subject to the area constraint and a strip-packing necessary condition: the number of columns of the largest class times s1 must be ≤ 1. Then construct the layout explicitly by placing the big class as a corner block and greedily tiling the L-shaped remainder with the smaller classes.
